working: ABC and ADC are both semicircles. Since R_ABC = R_ADC/2, the current divides as I_ABC = 2I0/3 and I_ADC = I0/3. Each semicircle gives a field of μ0I/(4r) at O. The two fields are in opposite directions, so B = μ0(2I0/3 − I0/3)/(4r) = μ0I0/(12r). The straight wires lie along the line through O, so they add no field.
